A nonextensible Review Fee Method enum delivers exactly Flat and Percent and associates each with the corresponding interface implementation.
A public CalculateReviewFee(Method: Enum "Review Fee Method"; BaseAmount: Decimal): Decimal procedure invokes the selected interface implementation instead of duplicating strategy formulas.
The example adds no table schema, invoice/posting writes, actual charge creation or scheduled execution.
